title: Words this player uses
description: Six terms from the player’s design. Turn a card for the meaning.

dialogs.answer: An HTTP request for part of a file, such as Range: bytes=0-1023. The player reads a zip’s index from its tail with one, and slices stored media out of the archive with more.
The two ways a zip keeps a file. Stored is the bytes as they are, readable at any offset. Deflated is compressed, readable only from the front.
A script the browser runs between a page and the network. Here it is the file server: it answers the H5P runtime’s requests from the archive.
How far an extraction has got. A request below it is answered at once; one above it waits, and follows the extraction as it moves.
An mp4 whose index, the moov atom, comes before its data, so the first frame decodes from the first kilobytes. Without it, nothing plays until the last byte has arrived.
The browser’s Cache API, holding an archive or an extracted file in 8 MB pieces, so a video can be served while the rest of it is still on its way.
